properties.name: jweb.api.base
properties.description: Base path for API endpoints

properties.name: jweb.data.enabled
properties.description: Enable database features

properties.name: jweb.dev.hot-reload
properties.description: Enable hot reload for development

properties.name: jweb.dev.watch-paths
properties.description: Comma-separated paths to watch for changes

properties.name: jweb.dev.debounce-ms
properties.description: Debounce delay in milliseconds before triggering reload

properties.name: jweb.performance.minify-css
properties.description: Minify CSS output

properties.name: jweb.performance.minify-html
properties.description: Minify HTML output

properties.name: jweb.performance.prefetch.enabled
properties.description: Enable link prefetching on hover

properties.name: jweb.performance.prefetch.cache-ttl
properties.description: Cache TTL in milliseconds

properties.name: jweb.performance.prefetch.hover-delay
properties.description: Delay before prefetching on hover in milliseconds

properties.name: jweb.admin.token
properties.description: Admin login token (blank disables admin login)

properties.name: jweb.admin.email
properties.description: Admin login email

properties.name: jweb.data.mongo.uri
properties.description: MongoDB connection URI

properties.name: jweb.data.mongo.database
properties.description: MongoDB database name

properties.name: jweb.dev.debug
properties.description: Show exception details and stack traces on error pages (dev only)

properties.name: jweb.dev.strict-html
properties.description: Fail a render on invalid HTML nesting (p(div(...)), ul(div(...)), a(a(...)), title outside head) instead of logging the pair once

properties.name: jweb.runtime.enabled
properties.description: Inject the JWeb client runtime (WebSocket events, state sync, DOM patching) into rendered pages

properties.name: jweb.metrics.micrometer
properties.description: Mirror jweb.Metrics into the application's Micrometer MeterRegistry when one exists (actuator + a registry); false keeps the built-in /metrics endpoint only

properties.name: jweb.runtime.expired
properties.description: What a page does when the server no longer holds its render context: banner (a fixed notice with a Reload button, the default), reload (reload at once), or silent (console only; page scripts get a jweb:expired event)

properties.name: jweb.runtime.reconnect-attempts
properties.description: How many times the client runtime retries a closed WebSocket (exponential backoff from 1s, capped at 30s) before showing the connection-lost notice; coming back online or to the foreground retries at once regardless

properties.name: jweb.websocket.allowed-origins
properties.description: Comma-separated origins allowed to open the /jweb WebSocket (blank = same-origin only)

properties.name: jweb.ai.enabled
properties.description: Enable the built-in AI module (chat, agents, tools) and the /jweb/ai/chat endpoint

properties.name: jweb.ai.base-url
properties.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL (OpenAI, Ollama, Groq, ...)

properties.name: jweb.ai.api-key
properties.description: API key for the AI provider (blank for local providers like Ollama)

properties.name: jweb.ai.model
properties.description: Default model for AI.ask/chat/agent

properties.name: jweb.ai.temperature
properties.description: Default sampling temperature

properties.name: jweb.ai.timeout-seconds
properties.description: Max seconds to wait for an AI provider response

properties.name: jweb.markitdown.command
properties.description: Path to the markitdown CLI used for document-to-Markdown conversion

properties.name: jweb.markitdown.timeout-seconds
properties.description: Maximum seconds a markitdown conversion may take

properties.name: jweb.sql.migrate
properties.description: Run the pending jweb.Migrations when the DataSource bean is bound to jweb.Sql at startup

properties.name: jweb.sql.migrations
properties.description: Where the V<version>__<name>.sql migration files are (classpath: or file:)

properties.name: jweb.pubsub.redis.url
properties.description: Redis URL for jweb.PubSub across instances (redis://[user[:password]@]host[:port], rediss:// for TLS); blank keeps the in-memory backend

properties.name: jweb.pubsub.redis.prefix
properties.description: Prefix of the Redis channel a PubSub topic is published on

properties.name: jweb.jobs.enabled
properties.description: Run the jweb.Jobs durable-jobs worker on this instance

properties.name: jweb.jobs.store
properties.description: auto = the jweb_jobs table when jweb.Sql is connected, else in memory; memory = always in memory

properties.name: jweb.jobs.poll
properties.description: How often the jobs worker looks for due jobs

properties.name: jweb.jobs.concurrency
properties.description: How many jobs run at once on this instance

properties.name: jweb.jobs.timeout
properties.description: A job still RUNNING this long is released to run again (its worker died)

properties.name: jweb.jobs.keep-done
properties.description: How long finished jobs are kept before being purged

properties.name: jweb.mail.from
properties.description: The From address used when a jweb.Mail message sets none

properties.name: jweb.mail.smtp.host
properties.description: SMTP server for jweb.Mail; blank keeps the outbox, which logs messages instead of sending

properties.name: jweb.mail.smtp.port
properties.description: SMTP port (587 STARTTLS, 465 implicit TLS, 25 plain)

properties.name: jweb.mail.smtp.username
properties.description: SMTP username; set to authenticate with AUTH PLAIN or LOGIN

properties.name: jweb.mail.smtp.password
properties.description: SMTP password

properties.name: jweb.mail.smtp.tls
properties.description: starttls, implicit (TLS from the first byte), or none

properties.name: jweb.auth.secret
properties.description: HMAC secret for jweb.Auth tokens (password reset, email verification) and the remember-me cookie; 32+ random characters, identical on every instance. Blank generates one per start.

properties.name: jweb.auth.remember.secure
properties.description: Mark the remember-me cookie Secure (behind HTTPS)

properties.name: jweb.storage.dir
properties.description: Directory of the local jweb.Storage store; ignored once jweb.storage.s3.bucket is set

properties.name: jweb.storage.path
properties.description: URL prefix the app serves stored files at; Storage.url(key) is path/key for app-served stores

properties.name: jweb.storage.access
properties.description: public, or signed: every Storage.url carries an expiry and a signature under jweb.auth.secret and the route serves nothing without one

properties.name: jweb.storage.url-ttl
properties.description: How long a signed or presigned Storage.url(key) lives

properties.name: jweb.storage.cache-control
properties.description: The Cache-Control header the storage route sends; blank for none

properties.name: jweb.storage.serve
properties.description: Mount GET <jweb.storage.path>/* at startup; false to mount Storage.serve() yourself

properties.name: jweb.storage.s3.bucket
properties.description: Set to use an S3-compatible bucket as the store (Amazon S3, Cloudflare R2, MinIO, Backblaze B2, DigitalOcean Spaces, GCS with HMAC keys)

properties.name: jweb.storage.s3.region
properties.description: Signing region (auto on Cloudflare R2)

properties.name: jweb.storage.s3.endpoint
properties.description: Service URL; blank for Amazon's virtual-hosted address of the region, otherwise e.g. https://<account>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com or http://minio:9000

properties.name: jweb.storage.s3.access-key
properties.description: Access key id

properties.name: jweb.storage.s3.secret-key
properties.description: Secret access key

properties.name: jweb.storage.s3.path-style
properties.description: Address objects as endpoint/bucket/key instead of bucket.host/key; default true with a custom endpoint, false on Amazon

properties.name: jweb.storage.s3.public-url
properties.description: A public bucket or a CDN in front of it: Storage.url(key) becomes <public-url>/<key> instead of a presigned URL

properties.name: jweb.observability.request-id
properties.description: The filter that gives every request an id: req.id(), X-Request-ID in and out, the MDC requestId

properties.name: jweb.observability.log-correlation
properties.description: Set logging.pattern.correlation so every log line of a request shows [requestId traceId]; set the pattern yourself to override

properties.name: jweb.observability.tracing
properties.description: Bind jweb.Trace to the app's ObservationRegistry when it has one (the actuator): framework spans become Micrometer observations and, with micrometer-tracing, spans in the trace
